source.stem:
A car travels 6.0 km along a main road in 6.0 minutes. It then travels 2.0 km along a minor road in 6.0 minutes.
Which calculation of average speed for the whole journey is correct?

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: In motion relative to the bus.

intelligence.enrichment: An object is in motion if its position changes with respect to the reference point with time. If its position does not change with respect to the reference point with time, it is at rest. position change with time relative to reference point -> motion; no position change with time relative to reference point -> rest The learner correctly applies this rule: An object is in motion if its position changes with respect to the reference point with time. If its position does not change with respect to the reference point with time, it is at rest. Motion is absolute: if the bus is moving, everything in it is simply moving for every reference point.
